notes: All 12 source and 14 target ids appear exactly once.
τόν before καλούμενον is `unrepresented`: the appositive is rendered by a bare participle with no relativizer or determiner for the article to keep (rules 23 and 31).
The names Ἰωσήφ, Βαρσαββᾶν, Ἰοῦστος and Μαθθίαν are each their own unit rather than sharing a head (rules 26 and 28).
